messages:
natalie: Heads-up — external assessor requested a retest window next week. We need a clear owner list for all open remediations + an evidence bundle (logs, presigned artifacts, RBAC snapshot). Can folks confirm owners by EOD? :eyes:
kevin: I can own the KMS/evidence packaging. Plan is to create ephemeral access via STS with a scoped policy. Will post the STS ARN + exact expiry window here shortly. :lock:
sam: For RBAC changes, can we avoid broad 'admin' grants? Suggest a pt-assessor-readonly role with least privilege for CloudWatch/S3/ReadOnly logs. That role should be time-bound and audited.
liz: Quick question — vuln #342 (S3 object ACL issue) still shows no PR. Who's taking it? It's a blocker for evidence redaction flow.
maria: I will pick up #342. Will open a PR this morning and request review from eng-sre. ETA noon.
jon: Proposed retest windows from the assessor: Tue 09:00-13:00 PT or Thu 14:00-18:00 PT. Which works for ops and oncall?
natalie: Leaning Tue 09-13 PT. Can oncall and kevin confirm? @ops-bot please mark tentative slot.
ops-bot: Tentative window recorded: Tue 09:00-13:00 PT. Please confirm 24h before.
kevin: Confirmed. I'll prepare ephemeral role and KMS grant for a 4h window overlapping the retest. Example STS command I'll generate for the assessor:```aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-readonly --role-session-name assessor-182999 --duration-seconds 14400```
assessor-bot: External assessor requires evidence upload endpoint and a manifest file format (manifest.json) listing artifacts + checksums. They prefer presigned S3 puts for large logs.
kevin: I'll generate presigned URLs and a manifest template. Example upload curl:```curl -X PUT "<presigned_url>" -T logs.tar.gz -H "x-amz-meta-owner:eng-sre"``` I'll post the real links into the evidence bucket and lock down ACLs.
sam: Reminder: RBAC snapshot must include current role bindings and a short explanation of delegation paths. Please capture via `rbt export-roles --timestamp` and include in the bundle.
liz: Once maria's PR lands, can we get a quick verification runbook step so assessor sees the fix? e.g., reproduce with `aws s3api get-object-acl` test.
maria: Will add verification step in PR description and add test commands.
kevin: Ownership summary for the thread: KMS + evidence bundle = kevin; RBAC snapshot + role creation = sam; vuln #342 fix = maria; retest coordination & scheduling = natalie/jon. I'll upload presigned links to this thread by EOD.
natalie: Perfect. Also note: auditor asked for 90 days of logs. If S3/CloudWatch retention <90d we need to export and include in bundle. Ops, verify retention or export steps.
jon: Oncall confirmed retention for prod logs is 180d, staging is 30d — we'll pull staging exports now and include.
kevin: Done. Packaging plan: create evidence zip named evidence_assessor_182999_YYYYMMDD.zip containing manifest.json, roles_export.txt, logs/, s3_acl_screenshots/, and remediation PR links. Will upload presigned and mark as READ-ONLY.
natalie: Thanks all. Final ask: add a short note in PRs referencing this thread_ts (1829990001) so we can trace. :thumbsup:
